rv.q: “This Is Our Youth” comes highly recommended, and runs through September 28 at the Greenhouse Theatre Center on Lincoln Avenue in Chicago.

Under Andrew Shipman’s direction, Gwydion Theatre Company’s intimate production elicits the roller-coaster ride of feelings of that certain age, which have not changed since the Reagan-era ʼ80s setting.
The three actors all perform highly believable characterizations—so believable that you may feel like a voyeur spying on their lives in this tiny theater space.
This company has taken up residence at The Greenhouse Theatre Center's "Studio 44" space. This is an intimate stage area with roughly 44 seats, and quite comfortable.

cn.t: Lonergan's 1982-set coming-of-age story still feels fresh and vital nearly 30 years later, powered by mesmerizing performances from its young cast that capture the visceral, roller-coaster emotions of youth in an intimate black box production.
